Google reportedly limits Meta's access to Gemini AI models

Google has reportedly restricted Meta's usage of its Gemini AI models, according to multiple reports. This action is attributed to significant computing capacity constraints faced by Google. The limitations come as demand for AI computing power, particularly for inference workloads, is overwhelming available resources, potentially delaying AI development for companies like Meta.
